faqs.question: What causes bathtub leaks?
faqs.answer: Common causes of bathtub leaks include damaged faucets, worn seals, drain problems and loose plumbing connections.

faqs.question: Can a leaking bathtub be repaired?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many bathtub leaks can be repaired by fixing damaged faucets, drains, seals or plumbing connections.

faqs.question: Why is my bathtub draining slowly?
faqs.answer: Slow bathtub drainage is commonly caused by hair buildup, soap residue, debris or deeper drain blockages.

faqs.question: When should I replace my bathtub instead of repairing it?
faqs.answer: Replacement may be better when the bathtub has severe damage, repeated leaks, structural problems or outdated components.

faqs.question: How long does bathtub repair take?
faqs.answer: Repair time depends on the type of problem, bathtub design and parts required for the repair.

faqs.question: Can plumbers repair bathtub drains?
faqs.answer: Yes. Professional plumbers can diagnose bathtub drain problems, remove blockages and repair damaged drain components.

faqs.question: How can I prevent bathtub plumbing problems?
faqs.answer: Regular drain cleaning, checking for leaks early and maintaining bathtub fixtures can help prevent future problems.
